verdict.rationale: Kino AI is an agent-driven video editor, so distributing standard agent skills to a team is a fair question for it, but the evidence documents no skill marketplace, shared skill repo, or project-committed skill files. Its 100+ built-in templates and shared project/review links are adjacent features, not team-wide skill distribution, and a community user noted reusable format templates were missing.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can distribute a standard skill set to my whole team — via a marketplace, a shared repo, or files committed to the project
